nosotros.desc: Free ultra-fast toolkit for web developers: WebP/AVIF compression, JSON/Markdown viewers, live SEO & Speed audits, and practical deployment guides.
nosotros.historia_titulo: 🚀 Real High-Performance Tools, 100% in Your Browser
nosotros.historia_p1: {app} ({slogan}) was built to solve everyday web development tasks without forced signups, watermarks, or slow intermediate servers.
nosotros.historia_p2: Engineered by {by} with modular Astro architecture and local browser processing, every tool prioritizes privacy, sub-second speed, and zero friction.
nosotros.historia_p3: All image conversion (ImgWii), JSON formatting, and Markdown rendering run locally on your device; live audits connect directly to Google PageSpeed and metadata endpoints.
nosotros.mision_desc: Give every developer and creator a fast, free, transparent suite to optimize images, validate data, audit SEO/Speed, and learn best practices.
nosotros.vision_desc: Make {app} the everyday go-to toolbox for modern web projects built with Astro, Cloudflare, Vercel, and Firebase.

valores.desc: Open any tool and use it right away—no mandatory accounts or artificial limits on local tools.
Your images, JSON, Markdown files, and personal API keys stay in your browser (LocalStorage).
Built with Astro, CSS theme tokens, and lightweight utilities with zero heavy bloat.
Full English and Spanish interface with light/dark themes and productivity shortcuts.

proceso.desc: Convert JPG/PNG to WebP or AVIF in /en/imgwii and batch-rename for SEO.
Format JSON in /en/lector-json and preview READMEs in /en/lector-md.
Inspect any URL in /en/seo-test with Google SERP preview and _headers generator.
Check FCP, LCP, CLS, and real page weight in /en/speed-test before launch.

pilares.desc: Hosted on Cloudflare Workers to respond in milliseconds from anywhere.
Plug in your free Google PageSpeed API key in /en/ajustes for unlimited audits.
Includes step-by-step guides for Astro, Cloudflare, Vercel, and Firebase in /en/aprender.
No intrusive ads or data selling—just focused utilities for developers.

terminos.desc: Clear and straightforward terms governing the use of the free tools in {app}, built by {by}.

clausulas.texto: {app} provides free web utilities for image optimization, technical file viewing, and SEO/Speed analysis.
items: You may use all tools for personal or commercial projects.
Local tools (ImgWii, JSON Reader, MD Reader) process files 100% in your browser.
We do not guarantee uninterrupted uptime of third-party APIs such as Google PageSpeed.

clausulas.texto: For SEO Test and Speed Test, you may use the shared system quota or enter your own API Key in /en/ajustes.
items: Any API Key saved in /en/ajustes stays strictly inside your browser.
Responsible usage helps prevent temporary Google rate limits.

clausulas.texto: We never claim rights over or store copies of the images, JSON, or documents you process on the platform.
items: Every converted or downloaded file remains 100% yours.
Clearing your browser storage removes all local cache.

clausulas.texto: If you spot an issue or want to suggest an improvement, reach out via our official channels.

cookies.desc: At {app} we respect your privacy. We only store technical keys in your own browser (LocalStorage) to remember your preferences.

clausulas.titulo: What do we store in your browser?
clausulas.texto: We use LocalStorage to remember your theme (Light/Dark), sidebar state, active guide in Learn, and your latest SEO/Speed report cache.
If you configure your key in /en/ajustes, it is saved exclusively in your browser and never sent to external databases.
We do not use third-party advertising cookies or sell browsing data.
You can clear local storage anytime from your browser settings or DevTools. Questions: {correo}.

filas.proposito: Stores your visual theme preference (Light or Dark) without flicker.
Remembers whether the sidebar is expanded or collapsed.
Restores the last viewed guide in /en/aprender.
Caches your latest SEO/Speed report for instant reload.
Stores your personal Google PageSpeed API key if configured in /en/ajustes.

privacidad.desc: At {app} we prioritize local browser processing so your files and settings always stay under your control.

clausulas.texto: ImgWii, JSON Reader, and MD Reader run completely in-memory inside your browser without uploading files to any server.
items: Your images, JSON, and Markdown files never leave your device.
Contact or Feedback submissions are stored locally in your session history.

clausulas.texto: When you analyze a public URL in /en/seo-test or /en/speed-test, that URL is queried via Google PageSpeed API and our metadata endpoint.
items: Only the public URL you explicitly enter is queried.
We never index or publish your audit results.

clausulas.texto: {app} is served entirely over HTTPS on Cloudflare Workers with active security headers.

contacto.desc: Have a tool idea, spotted a bug, or want to collaborate? Reach out directly.
contacto.form_desc: Your message is saved in your local history and helps us improve {app}.
contacto.ph_asunto: e.g. Suggestion for Speed Test or ImgWii
contacto.ph_mensaje: Tell us what improvement or feature you'd like to see...
contacto.exito_desc: Thank you for your message. You can also write directly to {correo} for a quick reply.

feedback.desc: Help us keep refining the speed and usefulness of {app} ({slogan}).
feedback.ph_comentario: What was most useful or what should we improve in v2?
feedback.exito_desc: Your rating has been recorded and helps us build an even better v2.

mas.desc: Access the rest of our developer tools and project information.
